description: Storage Rentals of America's Bacliff facility is conveniently located at 2919 N. Highway 146, offering easy access for residents of Bacliff, Kemah, and surrounding areas. Situated along the scenic Galveston Bay, our storage facility is just minutes from Bacliff Beach Park and the popular Kemah Boardwalk. With quick access to Highway 146 and a short drive from Interstate 45, we're perfectly positioned to serve residents and those commuting from Houston or Galveston. Climate Controlled Options: Our Bacliff location offers various storage unit sizes to accommodate multiple needs. From compact 5x5 units ideal for seasonal items to spacious 10x30 units capable of storing the contents of a large home, we have the perfect size for you. We feature climate-controlled units to protect sensitive items from Texas heat and humidity, and drive-up units for easy loading and unloading. Our indoor storage units provide an additional layer of protection for your valuables. Vehicle Storage Options: We offer convenient parking solutions for boat and RV owners to accommodate your recreational needs. Our facility features spacious parking spots for cars, boats, RVs, and trailers, ensuring your vehicles are safely stored when not in use. Our proximity to Galveston Bay makes us an ideal choice for boating enthusiasts looking for secure, accessible storage. Advanced Security Features: Security is our top priority at Storage Rentals of America. Our Bacliff facility has state-of-the-art security measures, including 24/7 video surveillance, well-lit premises, and electronic gate access. For added protection, We have an on-site management team at this property as well. Customer Service Excellence: At Storage Rentals of America, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service. Our friendly staff is available seven days a week to assist you with unit selection, answer questions, and ensure a smooth storage experience. We offer flexible reservation options you can easily reserve your unit online, over the phone, or in person at our office. We also provide a selection of moving and packing supplies on-site for your convenience. Stop by today and experience the Storage Rentals of America difference where your storage needs are our top priority.
